title: tshark: Improved profile support
description:
1. Treat profiles as "read only".  If global profiles are specified (with -C + --global-profile) just use the directory and don't make a copy of the profile in the personal directory
2. Add support in -G for listing global and personal preferences
3. Add same support to strato

Fixes #19944

AI-Assisted: no
